identity.title: Pokémon Ranger Vatonage: The Road to Top Ranger

leadText:
(Japanese: ポケモンレンジャー バトナージ～トップレンジャーへの道～ Pokémon Ranger Vatonage: The Road to Top Ranger) is one of the adaptations of the Pokémon Ranger series games. It was created by Ryū Matsushima. It appeared in CoroCoro Comics issue April and June 2008.

 
 

 
 

it:Pokémon Ranger Vatonage: The Road to Top Ranger
zh:寶可夢巡護員 風湧篇 ～頂級巡護員的道路～
